{{Quote|The Frangawl ruled Bardotta with an iron hand for most of its early history. They were warriors. Some would call them barbarians, but in fact they were men and women of spirit.|[[Savatte/Legends|Savatte]]|<ref name="Disappeared, Part I" />}}
The '''Frangawl Cult''', also known as the '''Frangawl clan''', was a [[Blood/Legends|bloodthirsty]] sect of the [[Dagoyan Masters/Legends|Dagoyan Masters]] that worshiped [[Malmourral/Legends|Malmourral]],<ref name="''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> the [[Bardottan/Legends|Phuii]] demon of war. The cultists concealed their identity wearing wooden masks carved to resemble fantastic creatures designed to instill fear in all who saw them.<ref name="NoP">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref>

==History==
The Frangawl Cult ruled [[Bardotta/Legends|Bardotta]] for much of its early history until they were banished by the Dagoyans,<ref name="NoP" /> though they prophesied a great darkness in the galaxy at the time when the Dagoyan Masters would disappear. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Frangawl Cult resurfaced and began kidnapping the Masters and their leader, [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Julia/Legends|Julia]], to sacrifice to Molmorral and fulfill their dark prophecy.<ref name="Disappeared, Part I" /> During that time, they also revered the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Witch/Legends|witch]] [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] as the Great Mother.<ref name="Disappeared, Part II" />
